verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the Public API supports CRUD on individual workspace resources. It also documents pagination and rate limits, but no batch or bulk endpoints for acting on many items at once. Reverse ETL warehouse syncs and Audience syncs to destinations are data-activation features, not user-invoked bulk operations, so they are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
